title: Middle D Sings Again  (O ré central volta a cantar)

segments.t: Na manhã de terça-feira a chuva já passou, e dentro do Quarto 9 Graham pousa sua pinça ao lado do piano aberto enquanto Evelyn se senta no banco de madeira. Ouça primeiro.
The new felt bushing is dry and the brass pin sits tight, madam.
Your hands are as steady as a watchmaker's, Graham. May I try the key?
Go right ahead—gently first, then full weight.
Listen... D! Clear, round, and zero rattle in the wood!
Sounds a tiny bit flat next to the note above it, doesn't it?
You have a good ear, Graham! Turn the steel tuning wrench a hair to the right.
Right here... tell me when to stop.
Right... there! Hold it! Play a warm G-major chord with me—listen!
Look at that—this old walnut box fills the whole glass room!
Wait until you hear Arthur's aunt's finished waltz tomorrow afternoon, Graham.
Let me screw the front panel back on and polish the brass pedals.
Thank you, Graham. After thirty quiet years, this piano has its voice back.
Agora vamos revisar linha por linha com a tradução em português.
The new felt bushing is dry and the brass pin sits tight, madam.
'A nova bucha de feltro está seca e o pino de latão está bem firme, senhora.'
Your hands are as steady as a watchmaker's, Graham. May I try the key?
'Suas mãos são tão firmes quanto as de um relojoeiro, Graham. Posso testar a tecla?'
Go right ahead—gently first, then full weight.
'Pode ir em frente — devagar primeiro, depois com o peso todo.'
Listen... D! Clear, round, and zero rattle in the wood!
'Ouça... Ré! Claro, encorpado e zero chocalho na madeira!'
Sounds a tiny bit flat next to the note above it, doesn't it?
'Parece um pouquinho baixo perto da nota acima dela, não parece?'
You have a good ear, Graham! Turn the steel tuning wrench a hair to the right.
'Você tem bom ouvido, Graham! Gire a chave de afinação de aço um fiozinho para a direita.'
Right here... tell me when to stop.
'Bem aqui... me diga quando parar.'
Right... there! Hold it! Play a warm G-major chord with me—listen!
'Bem... aí! Segure! Toque um acorde caloroso de sol maior comigo — ouça!'
Look at that—this old walnut box fills the whole glass room!
'Veja só — esta velha caixa de nogueira enche a sala de vidro inteira!'
Wait until you hear Arthur's aunt's finished waltz tomorrow afternoon, Graham.
'Espere até ouvir a valsa terminada da tia do Arthur amanhã à tarde, Graham.'
Let me screw the front panel back on and polish the brass pedals.
'Deixe-me parafusar o painel frontal de volta e polir os pedais de latão.'
Thank you, Graham. After thirty quiet years, this piano has its voice back.
'Obrigada, Graham. Depois de trinta anos silenciosos, este piano tem sua voz de volta.'
Agora vamos ouvir a conversa inteira uma última vez.

Wait until you hear Arthur's aunt's finished waltz tomorrow afternoon, Graham.
Let me screw the front panel back on and polish the brass pedals.
Thank you, Graham. After thirty quiet years, this piano has its voice back.
O ré central ressoa limpo e afinado, e o piano vertical de nogueira está pronto para a grande tarde de quarta-feira. Até a próxima.
See you next time.
